fields.name: SqlShardConnectionOptions shard-set configuration contract
fields.contract: SqlShardConnectionOptions exposes a writable SqlShardSets collection of SqlShardConnectionOptions.SqlShardConnectionsConfiguration entries. Its IShardSetsConfigurationOptions view exposes that collection as IShardSetConnectionsConfiguration entries through ShardSetsConfigInternal.
